description: Compute the trade balance for a country over one or more periods — total exports minus total imports — with optional HS or SITC commodity filter. Keyless preview makes two requests per served period, at least 4 seconds apart; authenticated calls batch periods. Returns the signed balance (USD), export value, import value, and coverage ratio (exports / imports). Note: mirror asymmetry is common — balance reflects values as reported by this country; the same flow may be recorded differently by the partner. Uses comtrade_lookup_countries to resolve reporter codes.

classification.description: Goods classification: HS/H0–H6 or SITC S1–S4/SS.

cmd_code.description: HS or SITC commodity codes to restrict the balance calculation. Serves the first 20 and discloses the remainder; input ceiling 200. Omit to compute the overall trade balance across all commodities.

freq.description: Frequency for both flows: A=annual YYYY, M=monthly YYYYMM (01–12). Omit to infer it from the periods; an explicit value must match them.

partner_code.description: M49 partner code (0–999); defaults to World (0). The balance uses the reporter’s values.

period.description: Periods, all annual (YYYY) or all monthly (YYYYMM); mixed lengths are rejected. Serves the first 4 keyless (12 with authenticated access); the rest, and any period whose export or import request is rate limited or runs out of time, are listed in unservedPeriods. Input ceiling 120.

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country (0–999). A partner-only code (0 World, 250 Metropolitan France) with no data fails with partner_only_reporter, naming the reporter-valid code when one exists (250 → 251).

name: comtrade_get_trade_balance

cmdCodes.description: Commodity codes used in the query (absent when querying all commodities).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `keyless_hs_edition_unsupported`: Explicit HS editions require authenticated data access. `invalid_reporter_filter`: Reporter omission lacks an explicit partner. `upstream_validation`: UN Comtrade rejects the query dimensions. `invalid_upstream_response`: UN Comtrade returns malformed trade data. `no_data`: No trade data available for the reporter and period combination. `partner_only_reporter`: No served period has data and the reporter code is partner-only in UN Comtrade reference data. `rate_limited`: No period was served and UN Comtrade rate-limited a flow through its retries. `deadline_exceeded`: No period had both flows complete within the call's time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

mirrorCaveat.description: Standard caveat about mirror asymmetry — balance reflects this country's reported values.

notice.description: Periods left out because a flow was rate limited (with the wait) or ran out of time, and possible incompleteness when a preview response reaches its cap.

partnerDesc.description: Partner name supplied by the returned records, or its numeric code when unavailable.

items.description: Trade balance values for a single reporting period.

balanceUsd.description: Trade balance in USD: exports minus imports. Positive = surplus.

coverageRatio.description: Export coverage ratio: exports / imports. >1 = surplus, <1 = deficit. Absent when imports is zero.

exportsUsd.description: Total exports value in USD for this period.

importsUsd.description: Total imports value in USD for this period.

note.description: Data note, e.g. when only one flow direction has data.

referenceNotice.description: Reference descriptions unavailable; codes and trade values retained.

unservedCmdCodes.description: Commodity codes beyond the 20-code work cap; query them separately.

unservedPeriods.description: Periods not served: past the period cap (4 keyless, 12 authenticated) or whose export or import request was rate limited or ran out of time; query them separately.

title: Get Trade Balance
